name: Building Complaint Disposition Codes
description: This dataset is a reference table of building complaint disposition codes, pairing each code with the disposition (outcome or status) it represents. With 160 rows and two columns, it serves as a lookup dictionary for interpreting complaint records in housing and building enforcement data. It could be used to decode disposition fields in complaint datasets, standardize outcome categories for analysis, or map codes to human-readable labels in dashboards and reports.
